Venezuela's Earthquake Aftermath Strains Health System

A series of earthquakes has hit Venezuela, causing widespread devastation and straining the country's already fragile health system. The World Health Organization (WHO) has expressed concerns about the impact on the healthcare sector. The twin earthquakes killed almost 2,000 people and affected over 15,000 more. As the country struggles to cope with the disaster, reports are emerging of kindness and resilience among survivors.
